# Hole: a dark pit disc r 0.38 m just above the floor, ringed by a steel rim (torus) proud of it.
# Origin at the centre on the floor. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Pit --base-color 0.2706 0.1686 0.2471 --no-slot
material new Rim --base-color 0.5137 0.6235 0.6510 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Pit --vertices 12 --radius 0.38 --depth 0.02 --location 0 0 0.03
material assign Pit
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh torus --name Rim --major-segments 14 --minor-segments 4 --major-radius 0.43 --minor-radius 0.075 --location 0 0 0.05
material assign Rim
shade flat
export hole.glb
